title: Mason's definitive context engineer direction and growth roadmap
body: The maintainer wants Mason to preserve engineering intent and prevent repeated AI coding mistakes as projects grow. Consult ROADMAP.md for strategy and measured progress. The original priorities remain trust, real evaluations, adoption without a required map, provenance, and quality-check evidence; Confluence stays lower priority. Usefulness rank and build order differ: correction capture is the highest-value outcome, but basic capture exists. On 2026-09-11 the maintainer authorized the durable advisory assessment lifecycle and broader audit evaluation. Explicit revision guidance now favors the existing ID when the same lesson changes. R8 and upload development trials passed maintained reuse in both Mason and notes; broaden independent validation before claiming superiority. Follow with executable constraints, contradiction review, a context debugger, explicit reconsideration conditions, and cross-repository coordination when demand warrants. Documentation examples are a separate feature: evaluate existing doctest/Twoslash tooling before custom compilers; the exploratory adapter is paused. Preserve reviewed history and unknown states; closing an advisory never implicitly approves a decision. Measure capture usefulness, later mistakes, incorrect closures, review effort and cost against ordinary notes. The initial patch comparison tied 10/10; smoke tests and passive audits do not establish superiority. Later milestones remain proposals. No roadmap owner or formal acceptance is recorded.

content.title: Mason's definitive context engineer direction and growth roadmap
content.body: The maintainer wants Mason to become the definitive context engineer as projects grow, preserving engineering intent and preventing repeated AI coding mistakes and missed updates. Consult ROADMAP.md for strategy and prioritization. The original five priorities were trust hardening, real patch evaluations, adoption without a mandatory concept map, decision provenance, and integration with established quality evidence; Confluence stays lower priority pending customer demand. Released mechanisms are progress, not proof of the goal: the initial live patch comparison tied 10/10. The growth-focused roadmap covers rationale, scoped ownership, evolving constraints, coupled changes, continuity across sessions, and manageable review/context costs. Its growth requirements are an explicitly labeled synthesis because the earlier assistant assessment is unavailable verbatim. The later automatic-use discussion is one proposed next milestone, not a replacement for the broader direction. Keep agreed direction, shipped capabilities, measured outcomes, and unapproved proposals distinct. The maintainer authorized capturing this memory; no owner or formal roadmap acceptance has been recorded.
